value.name: Asha closes binder and clears space
value.description: Asha closes the binder and sets it on the empty chair beside her so nothing remains between her and Lucia.
evidence: Asha closed the binder the rest of the way and set it on the empty chair beside her, so that nothing was between them on her lap anymore.

value.name: Asha promises to stay reachable
value.description: Asha tells Lucia she is staying and will keep her phone on until Lucia wakes up, while reserving any Haverford call before seven for herself.
evidence: "I'm staying," she said, "and my phone stays on until you wake up; if Haverford answers before seven I take that call, not you."

value.name: Lucia silently accepts Asha's terms
value.description: Lucia does not speak, but she touches the binder and glances at the clock, signaling anxious acceptance.
evidence: Lucia did not speak, but after a moment she reached out and laid her fingertips on the edge of the binder where it sat on the chair
and her eyes went once to the clock above the aide's desk and then came back.

value.name: Shared silence reveals Lucia's emotion
value.description: In the quiet after the radiator stops, Asha hears Lucia breathing in a way that suggests she is trying not to cry.
evidence: The radiator under the window cycled off, and in the new quiet Asha could hear Lucia breathing through her nose the way she did when she was trying not to cry in a hallway.

value.name: Asha and Lucia leave binder untouched
value.description: Neither sister moves the binder again, preserving the fragile truce between them.
evidence: Neither of them moved the binder again.

value.name: Asha proposes a call plan
value.description: Asha leans in, takes Lucia's hands, and suggests they decide who will call Haverford first thing tomorrow and write it down before she leaves.
evidence: Asha leaned forward and folded her hands over Lucia's upturned palms
"Let's decide who calls Haverford first thing tomorrow," she said, "and we put it on paper before I leave, so neither of us is guessing at six."

value.name: Lucia seeks confirmation about signing
value.description: Lucia slowly withdraws her hand, looks at the blank intake page, and asks whether they will both sign.
evidence: Lucia did not answer immediately; she drew her hand slowly back from where it had rested on the binder's edge and looked once at the blank intake page Asha had paperclipped to the front.
"So we both sign," she said, almost a question

value.name: Asha agrees to sign and reaches for pen
value.description: Asha nods and reaches for the pen clipped to the binder while still holding Lucia's other hand.
evidence: and Asha nodded and reached for the pen clipped to the binder's spine without letting go of Lucia's othe
